brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.evidence: Three level-0 bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;half-n) with top covers cover:0,0,0;full;top and cover:1,0,0;full;top forming a small desktop, dressed with mug and phone; house rules capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied, check_build ok, meshClash clear.
drawer:0#0,1#cut on the cut face of half-n base piece:0,1,0;half-n, dressed with pen/pencil props inside.

requirements.requirement: A spike at a corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 (mount variant) at junction of cells 0,0 / 0,1 / 1,0 — exactly the corner shared by the three bases.
setSpikeAccessory platform-sm fitted to the mount spike at that junction (small platform, not platform-lrg).

finish.summary: Compact 3-base desk unit: two full bases with top covers as the desktop plus a half-n base carrying a drawer. At the corner where all three bases meet, a mount spike carries the small platform (platform-sm). Open faces capped, joints locked, dressed with a mug and phone on the covers and pens in the drawer. check_build passes with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Compact desk unit with a drawer and a corner spike platform — inspecting the build and socket options first.

result.note: A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base first. Half-n and half-s take any drawer style; half-e and half-w take a slide, swing or long drawer (find_sockets offers those once the half base is on). No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.
